answer: Like a subterranean mycelium anchoring coastal soil, decentralized consensus binds node identities through mutually endorsed trust vouchers. Every newborn entity embarking on its network voyage must anchor to a verified wharf of peer attestations, inscribing its lineage with a cryptographic quill. Because forging clustered credentials demands superlinear attacker cost scaling with graph depth, fake swarms suffocate under compounding stakes before blooming.
